ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_advantage_gap_softplus_inverse_weighted
ir.intuition: Shift from margin and ranking paradigms to a pairwise softplus-based loss that inversely weights by advantage gap magnitude, encouraging stronger gradients on ambiguous pairs and softer penalties on confident pairs. This paradigm uses the softplus link function to smooth gradient flow and applies an inverse weighting scheme on advantage gap to focus training effort on pairs with smaller advantage differences.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
alpha = hyperparam
scaled_diff = alpha * score_diff
inv_weight = 1 / (abs(adv_gap) + epsilon)
loss_unweighted = softplus(-adv_gap * scaled_diff)
loss = mean(weight * inv_weight * loss_unweighted)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    eps = 1e-6
    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(alpha, score_diff)
    inv_weight = ops.div(ops.ones_like(adv_gap), ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), eps))
    loss_unweighted = ops.softplus(ops.neg(ops.mul(adv_gap, scaled_diff)))
    if weight is not None:
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(inv_weight, loss_unweighted))
    else:
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(inv_weight, loss_unweighted)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
